Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.wound.js.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.douglas.wound.js.startdescription: 'I feel for the bloke. I do. But he's not just a bloke any more.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.curse.json.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.curse.json.startdescription: 'I've had my differences with the Bureau… but in general, I'm glad the Duties have them… but this… this has gone very, very badly.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.observe.sc.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.observe.sc.startdescription: 'I have been asked to help the sufferers of a novel mania. They see shapes in the clouds - shapes that frighten and delight them. They wish to travel into the West. They insist. They grow violent…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.opera.apol.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.opera.apol.startdescription: ''Apollo and Marsyas' is to be performed again in Paris. It is a great work, Librarian… in more than one sense.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.pan.json.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.pan.json.startdescription: 'This curious matter in the Black Forest. I hope I can find something in the collection here to understand it better…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.project.in.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.project.in.startdescription: 'I had been planning to visit next autumn, to see Zuthi one more time… and now I'll never have the chance. However long one lives, one does not grow entirely accustomed to the suddenness of death.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.wound.json.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.ehsan.wound.json.startdescription: 'When I was Secretary Salvant, my first duty was to allay suffering. Now, it is only my first inclination…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.hunt.chan.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.hunt.chan.startdescription: 'You have heard the rumours about me, no doubt. You will understand that I am sympathetic to any who undertake a pilgrimage of flesh.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.mystical..label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.mystical..startdescription: 'Perhaps you know something of the Obliviates, Librarian - an order of Long who have forsworn traffic with the Hours…' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.observe.s.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.observe.s.startdescription: 'You know of course that Saint Tentreto was never recognised by the Church. But the traditions go back, to the Romans and before, in the isles and along the coasts of every ocean…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.omen.dawn.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.omen.dawn.startdescription: 'I shall tell you something in confidence, Librarian. I have long been haunted by a certain dream of eyes.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.project.s.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.project.s.startdescription: 'The High Executive for the Royal Endeavour has approached me for assistance with some of their more esoteric requirements…' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.rising.js.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.rising.js.startdescription: 'I have my own oracle from the Rising While. I believe I have a perfect understanding. I am here to make sure.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale>  as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.rite.awak.label: On the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.fraser.rite.awak.startdescription: 'There is an image in a church in Strasbourg that's been inspiring dreams of flight - dreams of blessed alteration. This, I would call spiritual progress. I'm concerned the Church may disagree.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.heist.j.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.heist.j.startdescription: 'Yes, this business at Oriflamme's. They admit nothing. But they have engaged me to make improvements to their vault.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.opera.a.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.opera.a.startdescription: 'There will be a production in Paris of an opera that celebrates the Grail. I have decided to offer suitable gifts to the performers.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.opera.w.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.opera.w.startdescription: 'Some cretin is attempting to stage the Invisible Opera in Venice. Well, I suppose if anything catches fire, Venice is less inclined than most cities to burn.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.project.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.project.startdescription: 'Now then, this Lark business. Zidane's gifts were mediocre at best, but I think I might salvage something from his work.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.project.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.project.startdescription: 'You are aware what the King is at? I suppose it will do well enough.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.revolut.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.hokobald.revolut.startdescription: 'More nonsense in the Bounds with the Legion. Always more nonsense. But I smell opportunity.'

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.julian.numa.wint.label: On the Softer Frost
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.julian.numa.wint.startdescription: '…another echo. Thomas, Eva, Matilda, Brian. Every name... ' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.observe.s.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.observe.s.startdescription: 'Something in the clouds above the Evening Isles, they say...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.opera.apo.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.opera.apo.startdescription: 'I wish to attend the première of an opera - one I have always very much enjoyed…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> or Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.opera.win.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.opera.win.startdescription: 'Again some imbecile attempts to revive l'opéra invisible. So much the worse for him.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.project.i.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.project.i.startdescription: 'Hello, my Librarian. I have become a patron of a project so delightful…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.revolutio.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.morgen.revolutio.startdescription: 'War in the Bounds again. Oh, Librarian… I can already scent the blood.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.heist.jso.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.heist.jso.startdescription: 'I'm looking into the Oriflamme's story - the theft, the forgeries.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.lost.find.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.lost.find.startdescription: 'This story from Miah - it interests me. I have an idea the House might help me follow up.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moth> as their <sprite name=moth> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.opera.win.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.opera.win.startdescription: 'You have heard they are attempting the Invisible Opera? In Venice? The impresario - he is a friend of mine. I wish he had listened to me.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moth> as their <sprite name=moth> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.project.i.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.project.i.startdescription: 'You've heard about poor Zuthi's death? I knew him in Algiers long ago. He was so sweet. And even then I knew he would be a very great talent...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.project.s.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.olympe.project.s.startdescription: 'This Royal Endeavour. I wonder what you think. No, don't tell me! I don't want us to get in trouble - either of us.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.heist.jso.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.heist.jso.startdescription: 'I am very interested in this 'theft' at Oriflamme's. I hope I can rely on you to be discreet?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.mystical..label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.mystical..startdescription: 'I've been asked to look into these solar movements. I don't imagine there's anything to it. But it would do to be sure.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.omen.dawn.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.omen.dawn.startdescription: 'Messana. The blindness? The farsight? I smell a Watchman's Name.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.project.i.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.project.i.startdescription: 'Zidane is dead. It's a pity: the man was an artist. And it's concerning: I wonder if the death might not have something to do with his last work.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.project.s.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.serena.project.s.startdescription: 'The New King… I have some concerns. I am certain it is a coincidence that he came to the throne so soon after the fire here at the House. An unlucky time. But it's a coincidence I have always disliked.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> or Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.curse..label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.curse..startdescription: 'I picked up one of those Grunewald pieces myself, you know... a waxwork. A little more restless than most waxworks, it turns out. Luckily for me, I've learnt not to trust the Bureau to do my job.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.pan.js.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.pan.js.startdescription: 'These patients; these alumni; shall I say, these initiates? My interest is doubly professional; as a priest, and as a gardener.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> or Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.rite.a.label: On the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.rite.a.startdescription: 'This saint-icon in Strasbourg. Apparently the candles are putting forth buds, and the vestry is haunted by pines. I've been asked for an opinion.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their <sprite name=nectar> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.rite.r.label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.rite.r.startdescription: 'The Grove of Green Immortals has asked me to look into this…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their <sprite name=nectar> Interest.]
